sentence: From 2022-02-14 to 2026-11-13 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +33.1% a year (worst drawdown -41.1%) against +35.0% (-42.1%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference -0.03 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.16, +0.10]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
